title: Pavito Pechay (East West Pavito): Characteristics
metaDescription: Pavito pechay is a pechay variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Pavito is a pechay variety, also sold or known as East West Pavito. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from East West Seed (also sold by Harbest Agribusiness).

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Pavito pechay is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for East West Pavito, this is the same pechay. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [pechay variety finder](/crop-varieties/pechay), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [organic fertilizer for pechay](/blog/organic-fertilizer-for-pechay).

Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest 25 to 30 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit pechay fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest 25 to 30 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Leaves: compact and short, with very dark green leaves and pure white, crisp stalks.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of the ten best selling East West seeds at Baliuag Marketing, a big farm supply chain in Bulacan (Agriculture Monthly), and among the most repurchased seed packs on Lazada. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual pechay on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Pavito pechay

Pechay is ready in about a month, so it fits small plots and quick cash. Pick a variety that bolts late in the heat and stands rain. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is East West Pavito the same as Pavito?
items.a: Yes. East West Pavito is another name for Pavito. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Pavito?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
